t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Use your intuition, certain colours are better than others but this can change at times.

vb_textbox.text: Certain colours are better than others, but this changes every once in a while. Try to remember the colours that score highly (5-8+ mushrooms) and choose those. If they start scoring low, refresh your opinion by selecting other colours - this is likely due to the point shift.
